text: もたせた　ポケモンは　こころが　やすらいで　なつきやすくなる。

structure.jp: もたせた　ポケモンは
structure.en: the Pokémon you gave it to hold

structure.jp: こころが　やすらいで
structure.en: its heart is put at ease and
it becomes quick to grow friendly

patterns.name: 〜やすい
patterns.explanation: やすい added to a verb means 'easy to do'; with くなる it means 'becomes easy to'. なつきやすくなる = 'becomes quick to grow friendly'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: もたせた　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. もたせた　ポケモン = 'the Pokémon you made hold it'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form (here で) joins one happening to the next, like 'and'. やすらいで = 'is put at ease and'.
